rvol_baseline: signal-minute volume divided by the strictly prior 90-session same-minute arithmetic mean
selection_policy: One frozen four-level schedule; no threshold or weight search
success_rule: Daily Sharpe improves, weighted net R is at least baseline, max drawdown improves, and paired Null-C Sharpe-uplift z >= 2
weakener: Net-R uplift is not positive in both pre-2023 and 2023+ eras
